_comment: Custom Bekaert Fencing theme v8: vc-frontend 2.51.1 built from source. Barlow typeface (BekaertText is proprietary, not redistributable); preset default/assets/presets/bekaert.json (primary #01ADEF, accent #FF602C); pill buttons; light utility bar and light footer panel; full-bleed hero with copy on the content column plus a CTA; 1800px content column; clickable category card carousel with a 'Discover All' pill; footer columns grouped from the flat CMS menu list; catalog mega-menu now shows a photo per category (childCategories query asks for imgSrc, which is carried through categoryToExtendedMenuLink into catalog-menu-item).
